name: Kibs Nine-Fingers
title: Scrapper Rogue / Infiltrator
role: Shadow-Meld, Critical Backstabs, Poison Coatings & Trap Disarming

recruitment_requirements.description: Rescue Kibs from perimeter scavengers or trade 75 Col worth of scrap parts.

bio: A crafty goblinoid scavenger operating out of the Meiji Dump. Possesses uncanny instincts for stealth, neurotoxin synthesis, and lockpicking.

loadout.armor: Cloak of Scavenged Shrouds (Light Leathers, +3 Stealth)
loadout.chest: Cloak of Scavenged Shrouds (Light Leathers, +3 Stealth)

equipped.armor: Cloak of Scavenged Shrouds (Light Leathers, +3 Stealth)
equipped.chest: Cloak of Scavenged Shrouds (Light Leathers, +3 Stealth)

Scrapper Infiltration.description: Unseen movement and exploitation of sightlines.

Neurotoxin Synthesis.description: Distilling monster venom into weapon coatings.

Lockpick & Bypass.description: Circumventing tumblers and runic electronic latches.

shadow_meld.name: Shadow Meld
shadow_meld.label: 👤 Shadow Meld
shadow_meld.tactical_effect: Melds into shadows; unleashes guaranteed sneak attack for 3d6+6 Piercing DMG + Bleed.

venom_coating.name: Venom Coating
venom_coating.label: 🧪 Venom Coating
venom_coating.tactical_effect: Coats party weapons in neurotoxin; attacks deal +1d6 Acid damage and inflict -2 to enemy saving throws.

lockpick_salvage.name: Lockpick & Salvage
lockpick_salvage.label: 🗝️ Lockpick & Salvage
lockpick_salvage.tactical_effect: Grants +4 bonus on all trap disarm and chest checks; increases party Col yield by +20%.
